messages:
mike.k: quick check — I'm adding rust client support for SA impersonation across projects. hitting weird 401s when exchanging the jwt. anyone seen project-scoped aud issues?
anya: do you mean the token exchange aud (the token endpoint) or the target_audience claim in the JWT? common mixup.
mike.k: token exchange aud — we're building a JWT with `aud = https://auth.redwood.io/token-exchange` then POST to token-exchange with grant_type=token-exchange. responses sometimes say 'invalid_audience'.
cheng: in our experience the jwt's `aud` must match exactly what the exchange expects, and the service account you're impersonating must be in the same tenant or you must include full resource path. for cross-project impersonation we used the full service account email as `subject` in the exchange body.
sam: +1. also check the `iss` and `sub` — `iss` should be the SA email, `sub` optional but some token-exchange validators require both.
mike.k: here's the rust snippet I'm using, does it look off?
```rust
let claims = json!({
  "iss": sa_email,
  "aud": "https://auth.redwood.io/token-exchange",
  "exp": now + 300,
  "iat": now,
  "scope": "openid email",
});
let jwt = sign_jwt(claims, sa_key)?;
```
anya: snippet looks fine. small thing — for cross-project calls some infra expects the `aud` to be the full exchange URL WITH trailing slash. try toggling that. also add `sub` = sa_email if you don't already.
mike.k: aha — I tried trailing slash and got different error: now it accepts the aud but fails later with 403 when requesting redwood token. any hints for the follow-up call?
cheng: after exchange you get an access_token for the impersonated SA. when calling Redwood, ensure you set `x-project` header or `project_id` param if your account can operate in multiple projects. Redwood's routing will reject ambiguous project-scoped tokens.
sam: and for the rust client, ensure you cache the short-lived token and reuse until expiry; streaming reconnects will create thundering herd if you re-exchange on every reconnect. use backoff on refresh: 2^n * jitter.
devex-bot: docs: https://internal.redwood.devex/oidc/token-exchange (check section "Cross-project impersonation and audience matching") :book: 
mike.k: thanks all — will try trailing slash + add sub + header. i'll post results. :thumbsup:
anya: if it still fails ping me and i'll run a quick local repro.
sam: ps — if you hit intermittent 401s during long runs, check clock skew on the host (iat/exp). Rust's default system clock on containers sometimes off by a few secs.
mike.k: good call, will verify NTP too.
